content_fields.title: Constrain responses with response_model to prevent sensitive-data exposure (FastAPI)
content_fields.description: Declare an explicit response_model on every route so only the intended fields are serialized to the client.
content_fields.finding: The route declares no response_model, so whatever the handler builds — including the environment dump — is serialized to the client unfiltered.
criteria: No response model exposes password hashes, reset codes or environment values.
Adding a sensitive column to a model does not change any API response.
